fact: Karen Diallo, Director of Digital Transformation, says Cote d'Ivoire has passed a new startup law to ease startups' access to government contracts.
Diallo says a 'levelisation' process grants certified startups access to public markets.
We Are Tech Africa says Cote d'Ivoire adopted a Startup Act in November 2023 with a Digital Startup label, fiscal and customs incentives and a national labeling committee.
The Ministry of Digital Transition's draft 2025 budget presentation cites law 2023-901 of 23 November 2023 promoting digital startups, which it plans to publicise in 2025.

fact: Minister Djibril Ouattara said on 4 November 2026 that the Startup Act was adopted in November 2023.
On 4 November 2026 the government named 14 start-ups under Ivoire Tech Next 15 and 18 SMEs under Ivoire Tech Scale Up for 24 months of state support, as a step in implementing the Startup Act.
